census_method: Manual inspection of package.json + src/ + tests/ + experiments/ + data/dependency-baseline.json

runtime_dependencies.name: @a2a-js/sdk
runtime_dependencies.purpose: A2A Protocol SDK — agent-to-agent federation (used by src/runtime/federation/service.ts)
runtime_dependencies.failure_behavior: FederationService constructor throws on missing AgentCard; mission-level optional, not core-blocking
runtime_dependencies.reproducibility_impact: none — core Genesis mission does not invoke A2A; A2A is opt-in mission-level federation

runtime_dependencies.name: @ag-ui/core
runtime_dependencies.purpose: AG-UI Protocol SDK — agent/application event interoperability (used by src/agui/event-bridge.ts)
runtime_dependencies.failure_behavior: AG-UI event bridge is opt-in; core Genesis mission does not require AG-UI emission
runtime_dependencies.reproducibility_impact: none — core Genesis mission does not invoke AG-UI

runtime_dependencies.name: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk
runtime_dependencies.purpose: MCP SDK — Model Context Protocol tool/capability interoperability (used by src/runtime/mcp/capability-provider.ts)
runtime_dependencies.failure_behavior: MCP capability provider is opt-in via WorkerGenome.tools grants; without an MCP server, the worker simply has no MCP tools
runtime_dependencies.reproducibility_impact: none — core Genesis mission does not invoke MCP tools

runtime_dependencies.name: yaml
runtime_dependencies.local_reference_substitute: n/a — pure-JS package, reproducibly available from npm registry
runtime_dependencies.failure_behavior: loadOwnership throws if data/ownership.yaml cannot be parsed; GenomeCompiler cannot construct without it

dev_dependencies.name: zod
dev_dependencies.purpose: Schema validation (devDependency despite being schema library; runtime dependencies do not include it)

external_services.name: OpenBot
external_services.purpose: Execution/computer runtime (worker shell + browser + workspace files)
external_services.failure_behavior: OpenBotRuntimeAdapter throws on missing OpenBot checkout / unreachable endpoint; mission fails loudly
external_services.reproducibility_impact: none — clean-room smoke mission uses MemoryComputer, not OpenBot

external_services.name: OpenDots
external_services.reproducibility_impact: none — clean-room smoke mission does not use OpenDots

external_services.name: OpenMuse
external_services.reproducibility_impact: none — clean-room smoke mission does not use OpenMuse

external_services.name: GitHub
external_services.purpose: Source code hosting + GitWorkspace operations (repo missions)
external_services.credential_required: GitHub PAT (for push; clone is public)
external_services.local_reference_substitute: tests/work/git-workspace.test.ts uses a local bare git repo
external_services.failure_behavior: git operations throw; mission fails loudly
external_services.reproducibility_impact: none — clean-room smoke mission does not invoke GitWorkspace

external_services.name: OpenRouter (Decisions API)
external_services.purpose: Jev Decision Model (typesafe/jev-1.13) — optional bounded probabilistic DecisionProvider
external_services.failure_behavior: JevDecisionProvider throws JevCredentialMissingError / JevProviderUnavailableError; no silent fallback
external_services.reproducibility_impact: none — clean-room smoke mission uses RuleDecisionProvider (production default); Jev is OPTIONAL

external_services.name: ZAI SDK
external_services.failure_behavior: ZAIReasoningProvider throws on missing SDK path; experiment-001 fails loudly
external_services.reproducibility_impact: none — clean-room smoke mission uses DEVELOPMENT_REASONING_FALLBACK
